faqs.title: What is a Collection?
faqs.body:
Collections are a special, time-limited feature where you can gather cards through chests and events.

  • You'll unlock the Collections feature after completing level 71.
  • Each collection lasts for two months, giving you plenty of time to collect and enjoy!
  • You can access collections by pressing on the cards icon on the bottom right.

faqs.title: What are Cards?
faqs.body:
• Cards are the core building blocks of a collection.
  • You can find these cards in card packs, which you can earn or unlock.
  • There are two different type of cards
    • Normal Cards
    • Golden Cards
  • Golden Cards give you double stars when duplicated and are also very rare to find whereas Normal Cards are common
  • Each card belongs to a specific set within the collection.
  • When starting a new collection you will receive a pack of four cards to start with.
  • Cards have a 1-5 star rating, with higher-rated cards being rarer and harder to obtain—so getting those special ones feels extra rewarding!

faqs.title: What happens to my duplicate cards?
faqs.body:
• Don’t worry about duplicates! They are automatically converted into stars, which can be used to open more chests and expand your collection.
    - The number of stars you earn from duplicates is based on the card's rating.
    - On collecting a duplicate golden card, your stars are doubled.

faqs.title: What are Card Packs?
faqs.body:
• Card Packs are available through events and tournaments, and they’re your gateway to new cards.
  • When you open a pack, you’ll receive a random set of cards—some may be duplicates, but that’s a great way to collect stars!
  • When starting a new collection you receive a single pack of four cards to begin with!
  • Each pack contains anywhere from 2 to 6 cards, so there's always something exciting to look forward to.

faqs.title: What are Sets?
faqs.body:
• Sets are made up of multiple cards that share a specific theme.
    - Each set has a unique theme and specific cards that a set needs.
    - Completing sets will help you complete an entire collection!

faqs.title: What happens if I complete a collection/set?
faqs.body:
- Completing a set rewards you with a special prize tied to that set.
- When you finish an entire collection, you’ll unlock a chest filled with amazing rewards and receive a unique badge that will appear on your profile to show off your achievement!

faqs.title: What happens when a collection ends?
faqs.body: Once a collection ends, all your stars and unclaimed cards will be reset. But don’t worry—any badges you earned will stay with you as a reminder of your accomplishments!

faqs.title: What is a Mystery Card?
faqs.body:
• Mystery Cards are special, event-exclusive cards you can only earn by winning certain events (e.g., Piñata Smash, Weekly Quest, Donut Craze, Sticker Hunt).
  • To collect them, join, play, and win the eligible event—rewards are granted on victory.
  • Mystery Cards do not drop from card packs or regular gameplay; they’re event-only.
  • Every Mystery Card is a 5-star, Ultra Rare card.

faqs.title: Why did I not receive the Mystery Card from the Pinata event?
faqs.body:
You would need to break open the 3rd Pinata for you to receive the Mystery Card  from the Pinata event

  • Breaking the 1st Pinata provides 3 cards (No mystery cards)

  • Breaking the 2nd Pinata provides 4 cards (No mystery cards)

  • Breaking the 3rd Pinata (Final pinata) provides 6 cards (Including 1 mystery card)
